// binary reader, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

namespace {

    // Copies row 0 of a 32x32 tile (four 16x16 faces) across the tile, in L1.
    template <typename T>
    void fill_rows(uint32_t addr) {
        volatile T* t = reinterpret_cast<volatile T*>(addr);
        constexpr uint32_t face = 256;
        for (uint32_t f = 0; f < 4; ++f) {
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
                for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 16; ++c) {
                    t[f * face + i * 16 + c] = t[(f % 2) * face + c];
                }
            }
        }
    }

}  // namespace

// Common arguments: b address, a address, groups_base, groups_extra, fill, nr, block, sr.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto b_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto a_args = TensorAccessorArgs<b_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_b = 1, cb_a = 0;
    const uint32_t b_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t a_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t groups_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t groups_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t fill = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t nr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t block = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(6);
    const uint32_t sr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(7);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = groups_base + (core < groups_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * groups_base) + (core < groups_extra ? core : groups_extra);
    const auto b = TensorAccessor(b_args, b_addr, 4096);
    const auto a = TensorAccessor(a_args, a_addr, 4096);
    for (uint32_t g = 0; g < count; ++g) {
        const uint32_t j = start + g;
        cb_reserve_back(cb_b, 1);
        const uint32_t b_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_b);
        noc_async_read_page(j, b, b_ptr);
        noc_async_read_barrier();
        {
            const uint32_t addr = b_ptr;
            if (fill != 0) {
                fill_rows<uint32_t>(addr);
            }
        }
        cb_push_back(cb_b, 1);
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < nr; r += block) {
            cb_reserve_back(cb_a, block);
            const uint32_t a_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_a);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < block; ++i) {
                noc_async_read_page(((r + i) * sr) + j, a, a_ptr + i * 4096);
            }
            noc_async_read_barrier();
            cb_push_back(cb_a, block);
        }
    }
}
